entries.wording: We will pick up your parcel from the sender soon.
A courier will pick up the parcel from the sender soon.
The sender has handed the parcel to Sameday and it will be processed in the Sameday warehouse.
The parcel is in the central warehouse waiting to be processed.
The parcel is on the way to the local warehouse.
The parcel has arrived at the local agency and will be prepared for delivery.
The courier will deliver the parcel soon. Additional details are available in the SAMEDAY App, email or SMS.
entries.note: Seen for deliveries to an easybox too. On the return leg the adapter files it under returned, as the app does.

entries.wording: The parcel has arrived at the delivery point. Pickup details are available in the SAMEDAY App, email or SMS.
entries.note: An easybox or pickup point; the pickup code is only in the app, email or SMS.

entries.wording: The parcel has been successfully delivered.
entries.note: On the return leg the adapter files it under returned, as the app does.

entries.wording: The parcel was redirected. As soon as it is in the courier's possession, it will be processed as requested.
entries.note: State 24, a redirection to a pickup point. An instruction, seen before the pickup: it keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.wording: The order has expired
entries.note: State EXPIRED_CANCELLED in the official app, which also labels it as a refusal. Status 74, a refusal by the recipient, is an exception under any state.

entries.wording: The parcel has been returned successfully
entries.note: State SUCCESSFULLY_RETURNED in the official app. Status 46, a completed return, is returned under any state.

entries.wording: The parcel has been redirected
entries.note: State ORDER_REDIRECTED in the official app. An instruction: it keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.wording: Delivery attempt failed
entries.note: State DELIVERY_FAILED in the official app.

entries.wording: The sender cancelled the order
entries.note: State SENDER_CANCELLED in the official app, a final state.

entries.wording: Delivery postponed as requested
entries.note: State DELIVERY_POSTPONED in the official app. An instruction: it keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.wording: Parcel picked up from recipient
entries.note: State PICKED_UP_RETURN in the official app.

entries.wording: The parcel is being returned.
entries.note: State ONGOING_RETURN in the official app.

entries.wording: Return loaded into pickup point
entries.note: State RETURN_IN_OOH in the official app.

entries.wording: Pick-up attempt failed.
entries.note: State PICKUP_FAILED in the official app: the courier could not collect the parcel from the sender.

entries.wording: The parcel is in international transit
entries.note: State IN_INTERNATIONAL_TRANSIT in the official app.

entries.wording: The selected easybox is full
entries.note: State SAMEDAY_POINT_CROWDED in the official app.

entries.wording: Parcel stored in the central warehouse.
entries.note: State PARCEL_KEPT_IN_CENTRAL_WAREHOUSE in the official app, which shows it as a waiting state, not a warning.

entries.wording: The easybox is temporarily out of order
entries.note: State SAMEDAY_POINT_TEMPORARY_UNAVAILABLE in the official app.

entries.wording: Incomplete delivery
entries.note: State INCOMPLETE_DELIVERY in the official app: only some parcels of the AWB were delivered.

entries.wording: Load failure into pickup point, redirecting to address.
entries.note: State PARCEL_REDIRECTED_TO_ADDRESS in the official app. An instruction: it keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.wording: The parcel has been redirect to another pickup point
entries.note: State PARCEL_REDIRECTED_TO_ANOTHER_OOH in the official app. An instruction: it keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.wording: The parcel has been loaded into the initial easybox
entries.note: State PARCEL_REDIRECTED_TO_INITIAL_EASYBOX in the official app, which labels it a load into the first easybox.

entries.wording: The package is unavailable for delivery
entries.note: State PARCEL_UNAVAILABLE_FOR_DELIVERY in the official app, a final state.

entries.wording: The package can no longer be delivered
entries.note: State PARCEL_CANNOT_BE_DELIVERED in the official app, a final state.
